description: Sends a real chat message through a connected chat account (LinkedIn, WhatsApp and other chat providers). SIDE EFFECT: the message is sent immediately and cannot be recalled. Exactly one mode applies: with threadId, the text is sent into that existing thread; without threadId, a new chat is started, which requires connectedAccountId (a connected account whose status is ok) and attendeeIdentifiers (the recipients' provider handles, i.e. the value of a contact's messaging channel), plus an optional chatName to name the group. New LinkedIn chats default to the Classic product; linkedinProduct set to sales_navigator or recruiter sends an InMail from that product's inbox (requires inmailSubject; recruiter also inmailSignature), and inmail true on classic sends an InMail to someone outside the network. A linkedinProduct that is not listed in the account's linkedinProducts is rejected. An identical text sent into the same thread within about a minute is rejected as a duplicate. A saved draft is sent by passing both draftMessageId and its opaque draftRevision, as returned when the draft was saved or shown in a thread's messages; threadId may then be the draft's own conversation. Each draft revision is sent at most once: a repeated send returns the first result with repeated true. A refused draft (changed, still sending, outcome unknown, or another version already sent) was not sent. Sends chat messages only, not email.

chatName.description: Optional display name for the new chat (group chats)

draftMessageId.description: Id of the saved new-conversation draft to send. Each draft revision is sent at most once; a repeated send returns the first result

draftRevision.description: Opaque revision returned with the saved draft; required whenever draftMessageId is provided

inmail.description: LinkedIn classic only: send as InMail to message people outside the sender's network (uses an InMail credit)

inmailSubject.description: Subject line of the InMail. Required for sales_navigator and recruiter

linkedinProduct.description: LinkedIn only: which product to send from. classic (default), sales_navigator or recruiter start the chat from that product's inbox; the two latter send an InMail and require inmailSubject (recruiter also inmailSignature)

workspace.description: Slug or id of the workspace to work in. Optional when the account has exactly one usable workspace; required when it has several. An API key always works in its own workspace.

name: send_chat_message
title: Send chat message
